description: Register a new app in AppCrane, either from a GitHub repository or from a prebuilt container image. Use this only after the user has explicitly confirmed they want to onboard a new app and told you which source to use — a real github URL, or an image reference for source_type='image'. Allocates ports, creates the data directories, configures Caddy routing, and starts health checks. After this returns, call appcrane_set_secret to set any required secrets, then appcrane_deploy to ship the first build. For an image app there is nothing to build: the deploy pulls image_ref and starts it, so also pass container_port and health_path unless the image happens to match AppCrane's own 3000 + /api/health defaults. Requires the create-apps permission (global admins, or any role a platform admin granted at Settings → Roles).

container_port.description: Port the image listens on inside the container. Omit only if the image really listens on 3000 (what an AppCrane-built image does); a third-party image usually does not — odoo is 8069, nginx is 80. Getting this wrong makes the app unreachable, not slow.

domain.description: Optional custom domain. If omitted, the app lives under CRANE_DOMAIN/<slug>/.

github_token.description: GitHub PAT for private repos. Stored encrypted; only used to clone.

github_url.description: GitHub repo URL, e.g. https://github.com/me/mysite. Required unless source_type is 'image'.

health_path.description: HTTP path AppCrane health-checks. Omit only if the image serves /api/health (the AppCrane-built default). A stock image will not, and a health check against a 404 marks a working app unhealthy.

image_ref.description: Prebuilt container image to run instead of building from source, e.g. "odoo:19" or "ghcr.io/owner/app@sha256:<64 hex>". Sets source_type='image'. The reference MUST name a version: a bare name ("odoo") and an explicit ":latest" are both REFUSED, because AppCrane records the resolved digest as the deployment's identity and against an unpinned tag that record is wrong as soon as upstream moves. A digest is the real pin; a version tag ("odoo:19") is accepted and is how you pick up a patch release on redeploy. Credentials never go in the reference — a private registry authenticates through the Docker daemon's own credential store, set up out of band.

slug.description: URL-safe identifier — lowercase letters, digits, dashes; must start with a letter or digit. Lives at /<slug>/.

source_type.description: 'github' (default) clones and builds a repo; 'image' runs a prebuilt image and never builds. Implied when image_ref is passed.

name: appcrane_create_app
